subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Should missing terminal events fail closed for every `openai-responses` endpoint, including custom OpenAI-compatible proxies, or only for endpoints known to follow the native Responses terminal-event contract?
rationale: The strict behavior prevents silent successful persistence and message loss, but it can intentionally stop existing nonconforming proxy setups that previously relied on EOF completion; repository policy treats this provider and fallback change as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Enforce the contract everywhere
options.body: Require a terminal response event for every `openai-responses` endpoint after rebasing, fixing the tool-use gap, and adding compatibility-focused coverage.

options.title: Scope strictness by provider
options.body: Fail closed only for native or explicitly compliant endpoints while preserving legacy EOF handling for other proxies through an owner-defined capability rather than broad runtime guessing.

options.title: Consolidate into the competing PR
options.body: Pause this branch and adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133 only after it gains equivalent HTTP/SSE proof and covers the compatibility decision.

recommendation.title: Enforce the contract everywhere
recommendation.body: Require a terminal response event for every `openai-responses` endpoint after rebasing, fixing the tool-use gap, and adding compatibility-focused coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to the Responses transport introduction, stream refactors, and the owner-level compatibility boundary.
